description:
Website Monitor checks your websites on a schedule and notifies you if they go down, so you can act fast.
The default interval is once every hour, and you can customize it per site – from seconds/minutes to longer gaps.
Features
- Monitor websites on a schedule with notifications when a site is down
- Per‑site monitoring intervals (hourly by default; customize from seconds/minutes)
- Custom monitor: continually check every few seconds or minutes
- One‑tap refresh for an individual website
- Pause or resume monitoring per website
- Choose which HTTP status codes should trigger notifications
- Search your list and drag to reorder entries
- Backup and restore your list (export to JSON, import from file)
- Share your website list or a single entry
- Smarter website icons with multiple favicon fallbacks
- Simple, modern UI with Material Design 3; Light/Dark/System themes
Privacy
- No login. No tracking. Your data stays on your device.
Open source
- Licensed under GPL‑3.0. Contributions are welcome.
